capability.summary: Convert one local JSON document to YAML text in a JSON envelope
capability.description: Reads one UTF-8 JSON file, parses any valid JSON root, serializes it with PyYAML safe_dump using Unicode and insertion-order keys, and returns the YAML text without writing a file.
capability.problem_space: One-way conversion of a local JSON document into YAML text for downstream consumption; not YAML file creation, YAML parsing, schema validation, or round-trip formatting preservation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing UTF-8 JSON document. Output: JSON envelope with generated YAML text or handled path/JSON syntax error; no file is written.
accepted_inputs: an existing UTF-8 file containing one valid JSON object, array, scalar, or null document
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "PyYAML", target: string, yaml: string}, exit 0. Missing path: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. Invalid JSON: {status: "error", tool: "PyYAML", message: string}, exit 1. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON; other file I/O failures may traceback.
limitations: returns YAML as a string inside JSON and never creates or modifies a YAML file
does not validate against a schema or preserve source JSON whitespace, comments, or exact scalar spelling
reads UTF-8 with no timeout or output truncation; non-JSON file I/O errors are not converted into the handled error envelope

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing generated YAML text or a handled conversion error; no output file is written.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: convert a JSON file to YAML text
serialize local JSON data as YAML
negative_intents: write or modify a YAML file
parse YAML or convert YAML to JSON
validate JSON or YAML against a schema
